hints.title: Core Idea
hints.text: We want to test if each bit from 29 down to 0 can be set to 0 in the final bitwise OR sum.

hints.title: Key Observation
hints.text: An element has 0 at candidate bit positions if bitwise `and` over a contiguous segment clears all forbidden bits.

hints.title: Algorithmic Steps
hints.text: For each bit position, check if we can form such segments using at most k bitwise `and` merge operations.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: Bit-by-bit greedy verification from most significant to least significant bit.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Evaluating all possible combinations of k operations is exponential.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use bitwise test mask and greedy segment partitioning.
